text:
The response breaks the explicit limit. The user asked for under 120 words, and this runs to roughly 200. The opening paragraph ("This section sets out...") is pure filler for a busy manager and uses up a large share of the budget.

Most of the content is accurate. The dates, the three-days-a-week rule, the formal-versus-informal distinction, the equipment exception, the hot desking details and the rationale all match the source.

There is one small distortion. The response says the Claims and Customer Contact teams are excluded "as their rosters will be reviewed in early 2027." The source says they are excluded because they already have shift-based rostered days, and the roster review is separate. The response also does not make clear that the exceptions for formal arrangements continue unchanged.

The content coverage is good. Lockers are omitted, which is minor.

The word-limit violation and the filler intro weigh heavily on concision, and the exclusion reasoning is slightly off.

Score: 3
